references.name: Claude Shannon
references.desc:
Father of information theory; central figure
connecting gambling, entropy, and investing

references.name: John Kelly Jr.
references.desc:
Bell Labs physicist; derived the Kelly formula
from information theory

references.name: Ed Thorp
references.desc:
Beat blackjack, pioneered quant hedge funds,
proved Kelly criterion with real money

references.name: Daniel Bernoulli
references.desc:
Discovered utility theory and the geometric mean
principle in 1738

references.name: Paul Samuelson
references.desc:
Nobel economist; fierce opponent of the Kelly
criterion

references.name: Harry Markowitz
references.desc:
Founded mean-variance portfolio theory; secretly
sympathetic to Kelly

references.name: Robert C. Merton
references.desc:
Option pricing theorist; LTCM partner who lost
~$100 million

references.name: Louis Bachelier
references.desc:
Forgotten 1900 thesis anticipated random walk
theory

references.name: Henry Latané
references.desc:
Introduced geometric mean criterion to
economics

references.name: Thomas Cover
references.desc:
Stanford professor; expanded Shannon's rebalancing
ideas

references.name: Warren Buffett
references.desc:
Met Thorp over bridge; coin-toss analogy for
market efficiency

references.name: Fred Schwed Jr.
references.desc:
Where Are the Customers' Yachts? —
Shannon's favorite investing book

references.name: Michael Milken
references.desc:
Junk bond king; connection between Princeton-Newport
and RICO prosecution

Proved Kelly minimizes time to any wealth
target
